scope: Daily evidence screening of all active canonical editorial lines against 27 Oct completed global market sessions and 28 Oct official RBNZ, ABS and SK hynix releases, with B3, Treasury, ICI and WHO primary evidence. This is a bounded daily review, not a claim of exhaustive worldwide absence.

No new primary archive or historical evidence change warranting an event-driven history study.

selection_reason: The material 28 Oct SK hynix, RBNZ and ABS deltas are already integrated into today's Global Macro; 23 Oct WHO outbreak data underpin a rejected 26 Oct thematic item and no new independent 28 Oct update was verified. A second article would duplicate the same evidence or bypass QA.
